summary: A venue that hires out rooms for weddings, conferences and parties: capacities by layout and head count, the spaces in detail, what is included, viewings, and an enquiry form with a live hire estimate.

pages.purpose: Show the place and answer 'will we fit?' immediately, then build trust: history, what is included, past clients, viewings.

sections.purpose: A wide photo of the main space with the venue's key facts as a short ledger (capacity, spaces, hours, location).
fields: Wide photo of the main space
Key facts: maximum guests, number of spaces, hire hours, district
Primary action: enquire; secondary: see spaces

sections.purpose: Pick a layout (banquet, theatre, standing, classroom…) and a head count; the spaces that fit light up, with combinations when no single room does.
alternatives: comparison-table: a small venue with two or three rooms
image-hotspots: show the rooms on a site plan
fields: Capacity of each space in each layout
sections.notes: List the fitting spaces as text as well as on the plan; announce the matches through aria-live. The chosen layout and head count are shared with the spaces page and the enquiry form.

sections.purpose: The story of the building or the venue: what makes it different.
alternatives: media-text: a short story beside one photo

sections.purpose: What every hire includes (furniture, AV, staff, cleaning, parking) and what costs extra.
fields: Extras with a note that they cost more

sections.purpose: Words from couples, companies and organisers who held events here.
fields: Client name and kind of event
Source if from a review site

sections.purpose: Book a viewing: map, address, viewing hours and how to arrange one.
Own caterer, curfew, how to hold a date, accessibility.
fields: Questions and answers: outside catering, latest finish, holding a date and deposit, accessibility, noise rules

sections.purpose: Close with the enquiry action and the reply promise.

pages.purpose: Every room in detail: photos, measurements, capacity in each layout and the day rate.

sections.purpose: Total floor area, hire hours and a note on weekday/weekend rates.
The capacity finder in detailed mode: each space with photos, floor, ceiling height, notes and its capacity in every layout.
alternatives: comparison-table: capacities as one table across spaces

pages.purpose: Collect everything needed to quote and hold a date, with a live hire estimate.

sections.purpose: How long a date is held while you talk and who replies when.
fields: Hold period for a provisional date
Reply time and contact person role

sections.purpose: Event type, date, guests and layout (carried from the finder), spaces, catering, budget and contact, with a running estimate.
alternatives: multi-step-form: long enquiries split into steps
contact-form: a simple venue without pricing
sections.notes: Date picker with a minimum lead time; warn when the picked spaces do not fit the guest count; the estimate is an aria-live region and clearly labelled as an estimate. Validate on submit with errors next to fields.

content: Venue name, address, map location and transport/parking
Every space: name, photos, size, ceiling height, floor, character
Capacity of each space per layout and which spaces combine
Day rates and how weekends/seasons change them
What every hire includes and what costs extra
Catering policy (in-house, approved list, own caterer)
Hire hours, curfew and noise rules
Viewing hours and how to book a viewing
How a date is held (provisional hold, deposit)
Client quotes and the building's history (optional)

styles.name: heritage serif
styles.why: Warm terracotta, a heritage serif and mono figures for capacities; suits historic buildings, barns, mills and wedding venues.

styles.name: modern event space
styles.why: Clean, photo-led look for conference centres, studios and urban event spaces.

pitfalls: The site plan is the only source of which rooms fit; list fitting rooms as text too.
The hire estimate reads like a quote; label it as an estimate and say what it excludes.
Capacities given without the layout (a room seats far fewer at a banquet than standing).
Outdoor spaces shown without their seasonal or weather limits.
Catering and curfew rules hidden until the enquiry, causing wasted viewings.
Heavy scroll motion without honouring prefers-reduced-motion.
Choices made in the finder lost when the visitor moves to the enquiry form or switches language.
